title: 第930章 不准监守自盗第929章 投鼠忌器虚与委蛇
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: 闻言，夜玄面上无动于衷。
一息。
二息。
三息。
众目睽睽下，青年缓缓开口，“说来惭愧，晚辈刚突破八阶不久，自身实力孱弱，怕是难以应对妖府那些强者。”
此话一出，不少长老暗地里翻起白眼。
都有九阶御兽师傍身，还搁这儿说实力孱弱呢？那名九阶御兽师虽然口口声声说没有契约妖宠，可谁敢赌？方才那御兽师天赋威势，明明白白摆在那里，那种碾压一切的九阶力量，岂是没有契约妖宠就能轻视的？
只能说火陇人老成精，知晓人心。
越是说自己没有妖宠，越是让人忌惮。
“这小子说这番话，摆明是想从联盟捞好处。”
新任盟主厉间心中暗暗嘀咕，面上却依旧挂着那副温和热切的笑容：
“无妨！
我联盟虽不算富甲天下，但也不缺魔植魔药，培养夜圣子绰绰有余。”
“这样吧，联盟宝库正缺个管事。”
“夜圣子若是有兴趣，可愿担此职？”
厉间话一出口，在场不少长老倒吸冷气。
联盟宝库管事——那可是实打实的肥差！
不仅掌管着联盟多年积攒的珍稀资源，更有着调度和分配宝库物资的权力。
这个位置向来由盟主心腹担任，厉间竟愿意将它交给夜玄？
夜玄闻言。
心中同样一惊。
他轻笑一声，“盟主倒是大方，不过宝库管事这位置，怕是不少人盯着。”
“晚辈初来乍到，若贸然接手，只怕会惹人闲话。”
厉间闻言，连连摆手：“夜圣子多虑了！”
“以你的能力和资历，担此职位绰绰有余。”
“若是有人不服，让他来找老夫便是。”
众长老心中唏嘘不已。
这就是有背景的好处啊！
九阶御兽师一出，连盟主的态度都来了个一百八十度大转弯。
前一秒还在想着怎么唱白脸、唱黑脸，从小辈身上套好处。
后一秒，就把联盟宝库管事的位置双手奉上。
就差把“你可以监守自盗”
content_en:
Hearing this, Ye Xuan looked indifferent.
One breath.
Two breaths.
Three breaths.
Under the gaze of everyone, the young man slowly spoke, "I'm ashamed to say that I have just broken through the eighth level, and my own strength is weak. I'm afraid it will be difficult to deal with the strong ones in the Demon Mansion."
As soon as these words came out, many elders secretly rolled their eyes.
There are even ninth-level beastmasters standing by, so why are you saying that your strength is weak? Although the ninth-level beast master keeps saying that he does not have a contracted demon pet, who dares to bet? The innate power of the beast master just now was clearly there. That kind of ninth-level power that crushed everything could not be despised without a contracted demon pet?
It can only be said that Huolong people are mature and know people's hearts.
The more he said he didn't have a demon pet, the more people feared him.
"This guy said this because he clearly wants to gain benefits from the alliance."
The new alliance leader Li Jian secretly murmured in his heart, but still had that gentle and eager smile on his face:
"No problem!
Although our alliance is not the richest in the world, it does not lack magic plants and potions, and it is more than enough to train Ye Shengzi. "
"Well, the Alliance Treasure House is in need of a manager."
"If Saint Son Ye is interested, would you be willing to take on this position?"
"Hiss..."
As soon as Li Jian's words came out, many elders present gasped.
The Alliance Treasure House Manager - that's a real fat job!
Not only is he in charge of the rare resources accumulated by the alliance over the years, but he also has the power to schedule and distribute the treasure trove of materials.
This position has always been held by the alliance leader's confidant, but Li Jian is actually willing to hand it over to Ye Xuan?
Ye Xuan heard this.
I was equally surprised.
He chuckled lightly, "The alliance leader is quite generous, but the treasure house manager's position may attract many people's attention."
"This junior is new here. If you take over rashly, I'm afraid it will cause gossip."
Hearing this, Li Jian waved his hands repeatedly: "Shengzi Ye is worrying too much!"
"With your abilities and qualifications, you are more than qualified for this position."
"If anyone is dissatisfied, just ask him to come to me."
All the elders were filled with sadness.
This is the benefit of having a background!
As soon as the ninth-level beast master appeared, even the alliance leader's attitude made a 180-degree turn.
One second ago, I was thinking about how to flatter or blame others and take advantage of the younger ones.
The next second, he offered the position of steward of the alliance's treasury with both hands.
Just "You can guard and steal"
title_en: Chapter 930: No one is allowed to guard and steal. Chapter 929: Surrender to rats and avoid using false weapons and surrendering to snakes.
